rank.description: Final rank; ties share a rank.

tied.description: True when another fan shares this rank.

title.description: Short display title, e.g. 'FCS Playoff Pick'em champion'.

league.description: League code as used in game records, e.g. 'NCAAF'.

status.description: Absent means active. Revoked awards (a grading correction) stay as a record so badges pointing at them can say why; readers must not show a revoked award as earned.

contest.description: The com.professorbutts.sports.contest record (or another contest-like record) the award is for.

standings.description: Public page with the final standings.

contestCid.description: Optional CID of the contest version the final standings were computed from.

achievement.description: For kind #secret (and other special awards): which achievement this is, a short slug chosen by the issuer.

description.description: Optional line on how it was earned.

main.description: Recommended key: '<contest rkey>-<kind>-<first 16 hex of sha256(subject DID)>', so a fan gets at most one award of each kind per contest.

secret.description: A hidden achievement; its name is not published until someone earns it. See achievement.

entrant.description: Entered the contest (saved an entry before it locked).

perfect.description: Every graded pick was correct (at least one game).

description: An award issued by a contest's publisher to one fan, e.g. the champion of a pick'em contest. Lives in the issuer's repo; the fan can keep it on their profile with a com.professorbutts.sports.badge record that points here. An award is genuine when it is in the contest publisher's repo and its subject is the fan.
